title: updateRulesMetrics derives per-org breakdowns from rule labels in one pass
answers: Where are alert rule label-based metrics computed?
How does the scheduler know which org/plugin a rule belongs to for metrics?
Where is the __grafana_origin label consumed for fleet-wide metrics?
body:
pkg/services/ngalert/schedule/metrics.go:updateRulesMetrics iterates all schedulable alert rules once per tick, bucketing by rule.OrgID and then by a label value (e.g. models.PluginGrafanaOriginLabel for plugin origin, group for rule groups, an import marker for Prometheus-imported rules). Rules without the relevant label are silently excluded from that metric rather than counted under an empty key.
This is the place to add new label-derived, per-org fleet metrics without introducing extra passes over alertRules.
applies: ngalert scheduler metrics computed per tick from the in-memory rule list
